Listen to 9to5Mac Daily every morning as we cover the latest Apple headlines and breaking news. 9to5Mac Daily is available on iTunes and Apple's Podcasts app, Stitcher, TuneIn, Google Play, or through our dedicated RSS feed in Overcast and other podcast players.

It's a simple to-do list app for iPhone, iPad, and Mac, with powerful tools that make organizing, tracking, and completing tasks deeply satisfying. Get stuff done with Stuff.

New episodes of 9to5Mac Daily are recorded every weekday. Be sure to subscribe to our podcast in Apple Podcasts or your favorite podcast player to get new episodes delivered to your ears as soon as they're released.

Stories discussed in this episode:

  • iPhone 18 Pro Max battery capacity is massive, requires this brand new feature added in iOS 27
  • iPhone 18 Pro Max still uses Qualcomm modem for US models, teardown confirms
  • iOS 27.2 will help users transfer data and settings from old apps to their replacements
  • Storage space required for Apple Intelligence on latest iPhones nearly doubles
